calibration:
# ToF 8x8 module placement on the left side of the RB head cover.
schema_version: 1
sensor:
  name: tof_8x8
  parent_link: body_link
  position_body_m: [0.087603, 0.020098, 0.0918] # module center; +Y is robot-left.
  xyaxes_body: [-0.069756, -0.997564, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0] # optical axis yaw -4 deg from +X.
  board_size_m: [0.002, 0.01, 0.01] # full X/Y/Z dimensions; generic render placeholder
  window_size_m: [0.0004, 0.005, 0.005]
  fovy_deg: 45
  min_range_m: 0.02
  max_range_m: 4.0
  frame_rate_hz: 15
  noise:
    near_accuracy_m: 0.014 # 20–200 mm, 8x8 gray target at 5 kLux
    far_accuracy_fraction: 0.08 # 200–4000 mm, 8x8 gray target at 5 kLux
    corner_extra_fraction: 0.04
    sigma_fraction_of_bound: 0.1666666667 # half the previous simulated jitter
  # shortcut: package dimensions are generic because the exact ToF board CAD was not supplied; replace with vendor CAD when available.
mapping: encoder/gyro odometry; 5cm voxel; observed free slices, not clearance
